title: The ABCD Lab welcomes new batch of research scholars at SBS, NISER
excerpt: New PhD and Master students have joined the laboratory to explore bacterial cytoskeletal dynamics and division.
content: We welcome our new cohort of enthusiastic researchers embarking on their scientific journeys in prokaryotic cell biology.

title: Research grant awarded for high-resolution bacterial imaging
excerpt: The ABCD Lab has been awarded research funding to advance quantitative microscopy of macromolecular division assemblies.

title: Breakthrough findings on bacterial cytoskeletal polymer architecture
excerpt: Our team uncovered novel insights into the spatial coordination of actin-like filaments during cell division.

title: Paper published on single-molecule tracking of divisome complexes
excerpt: Our study describing divisome maturation kinetics is now available open access.
